statement: One retail RVL-036 Wii Remote Plus advertising Nintendo RVL-CNT-01 returned the same 217-byte HID report descriptor in two SDP reads and the bound Linux hidraw read, with raw SHA-256 4d40cb52850ded69a8c1474fff35dfd3e102d4b10ad3579258ab37f4a36fb3ef.

applicability.revision: Owner-reported case model RVL-036 (Wii Remote Plus), Bluetooth name Nintendo RVL-CNT-01
applicability.scope: One retail RVL-036 with the RVL-CNT-01 Bluetooth identity. Other controller specimens and revisions, including RVL-CNT-01-TR, were not measured.
